name: The Hall of Guides
description: The Feywood's specialist organization for civilian-coded escort of sanctioned visitors through the realm's liminal geometry. The Hall of Guides operates without arms-ready posture, navigating the Feywood's shifting paths through accumulated relationship with the land rather than through martial vigilance. Membership is distinguished by geometry-reading capability — the specialist skill of knowing when the Feywood is opening for a party, when it is not, and how to move through the land's cooperation. The Hall is led by the Master of Guides; House Silverbough is overrepresented at all levels and disproportionately at the Master role through generational Outer Wild knowledge and ecological stewardship; the Hall is not house-bound. Approximately sixty active Guides operate at any given time. Working sites center on Vaelmere (visitor reception) and distributed presence across the Feywood for active escorts; coordination work conducted at Thornveil.
